reviews.text: My dog ​​was treated extremely well on his first day at daycare! You can trust them without any fear!
They are very careful and love animals. We have been customers for years.
By far the best pet shop to leave your dog!! Excellent space, facilities, and location. Humane service with lots of love and respect for our pets! Congratulations!

We left Granola at Clubpet while we traveled, and it was amazing. We received photos, and she was happy and playing with her doggy friends! You could see from the pictures that she was well cared for and happy while we were away. I trust them completely!

I contacted Club Pet RJ to get more information about pet boarding. I received correct guidance regarding the required criteria, such as deworming, up-to-date vaccinations, and general animal care.
After consulting the website, I decided to continue the service via WhatsApp and inquired about the existence of 24-hour video monitoring. The answer was: "No, we send photos and updates via WhatsApp twice a day to each client."
Honestly, this worried me. A place that aims to care for dogs and other pets should offer greater transparency and security to pet owners. Nowadays, video monitoring is an essential feature, as it allows you to follow the well-being of pets in real time.

I believe that this type of feature should be standard in these establishments, as is already the case in many pet shops, where it is possible to see the animals during bathing or other procedures.
As a pet owner, I consider it essential to have this peace of mind. Video monitoring is not excessive, but rather a way to ensure safety, trust, and respect for the animals and their owners.

When Snoopy (my puppy) was 3 months old, I needed a place where he could interact with both people and other dogs. I was apprehensive because he was reactive to people and had some issues to work through.

From the beginning, I received a lot of encouragement from Fabiana (the owner), who was always very attentive, careful, and loving throughout the process. He improved a lot and is much better now.

It's a place I can trust, and I know that if any problem arises, I can speak directly to Fabiana, who responds promptly.

Thank you to the whole team! I always receive photos of him. They are organized and attentive.

Thank you, Fabi, for all your dedication and patience. 1000 out of 10!

I left my puppy at this place for about an hour during the adaptation period and stayed close by. Initially, I wasn't very confident because he's a very small Chihuahua, but based on the reviews, website, and WhatsApp service, it seemed good. I also really wanted to socialize him and provide the experience they theoretically promise. However, the staff there were extremely rude, and it wasn't at all true to what they offered… the puppies were crammed into a tiny room, bumping into each other, without toys or activities, and I didn't see any water bowls. I was apprehensive, and the person in charge, Hilda, insisted I leave in a very rude and forceful way, which I found very strange. They sent some photos of him outside in 40°C heat, insisting I not come back, saying I was disrupting the adaptation experience. When I went to pick him up, they said, "Get the scaredy-cat over there," and brought him back completely covered in feces, clearly uncomfortable, and the lack of empathy and care was even more evident. I believe that to run a business like this, you have to love dogs and what you do, and prioritize making the owner feel comfortable entrusting their beloved pet there… that doesn't happen. I can't stress enough in a single comment how much I strongly discourage this place. I'm even glad I paid the 60 reais they charged me for this horrible experience just to be sure it's not worth going back; I feel sad for those who leave their little one there without knowing how they're being treated.

Wonderful experience using Club Pet's services for the first time.
Highly professional team with a very important differentiating factor: unconditional love and care for animals. I recommend them without hesitation.
Marcelo Berman
Good afternoon, our records show that you have used any of our services. How can you rate us if you haven't even tried our services?

I was there in November with my family, and based on the reviews, I decided to "try out" leaving my dog ​​there. We were informed that it would be necessary to leave him there for an hour to see if he would adapt. Okay! We took him in the afternoon. My wife commented that she didn't feel comfortable. They didn't show us the facilities and were quite "dry" in their service. Even so, we left him, with heavy hearts, and went to the Jockey Club while he stayed there for this adaptation period. After 50 minutes, we returned. We were informed that everything was okay and that he was "approved" to stay there. They charged R$50.00 (which was only mentioned when we went to pick him up). To my surprise, when I called my dog, who always gets VERY excited when he sees me, he simply ignored me. That night he bit my daughter when she tried to pet him. He was distraught for a whole week. I don't know what happened. But I will never take him there again, nor will I recommend it.
EXCELLENT!!!!!! My dog ​​was rescued and has serious behavioral problems. But when she goes to Club Pet she feels at home! The affection and care from the monitors and staff make all the difference!

Review of the Club Pet Leblon Rio de Janeiro Experience

I would like to share Sol's wonderful experience at Club Pet Leblon RJ 🐾✨ From the moment I left Sol ☀️ after much research, visits, and online reviews, I knew she would be in good hands, but throughout her stay, they exceeded expectations.

The staff was extremely attentive and dedicated, ensuring my pet received all the attention, affection, and care she needed. During her stay, I received constant updates, photos, and videos, which made me very calm and happy.

The space is well-structured, clean, and safe, and they are concerned with offering activities that stimulate the well-being of the animals, always respecting the limits of each one. Sol ☀️ seemed so happy and comfortable.

I wholeheartedly recommend boarding at Club Pet Leblon Rio de Janeiro to anyone looking for a reliable place with special care for pets. We will definitely return whenever we need to!

Thank you so much to the team for taking such good care of my little one! 🐶💖

After discovering Club Pet, I became a fan. My mixed-breed dog, Lia, had socialization problems, but she started attending the club weekly and her behavior changed. Today she is clearly a happier companion. Thank you to the whole team!

Wonderful place for dogs. Love and lots of playtime...
Always a joy and tranquility for owners and their pets.
There's no better place!!!

Fred and Praya had been to daycare before, but never stayed overnight. It was a success! When they saw me, they didn't even want to go home. I could travel peacefully, without worrying because I knew they were being well cared for and …
Thank you so much for your feedback!
